model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.54 m, eave 3.64 m, ridge 6.07 m above the ground
gable 硬山 or 悬山, rolled ridge 卷棚, 2 parallel rolls 勾连搭, grey tile

by the hall kit: 3 bays, the middle widest, a porch front, steps on the front, left, 硬山 flush gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

evidence.title: 御製古香齋題壁
evidence.excerpt_zh: 乾隆六年御製古香齋題壁　書屋誠清絶翛然水石邊時來聴泉響獨坐愛巖懸日永人偏静齋深爽更延忘言翻舊卷髣髴話當年
evidence.summary: Short poem written on the wall of 古香齋: the sound of spring water, an overhanging rock and quiet.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 长春仙馆
evidence.excerpt_zh: 長春仙館之西為含碧堂五楹堂後為林虚桂静左為古香齋其東楹有閣為抑齋林虚桂静東稍南為墨池雲後有殿為隨安室（圓明園冊）臣等謹按含碧堂諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: West of 長春仙館: the five-bay 含碧堂, with 林虚桂静, 古香齋, 抑齋 in its east bay, 墨池雲, and 隨安室 at the rear.

evidence.title: 古香斋: 乾隆六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆六年 (1741), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 书屋诚清絶，翛然水石边。时来聴泉响，独坐爱岩悬。日永人偏静，斋深爽更延。忘言翻旧巻，髣髴话当年。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 古香斋, 1741, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 古香斋
evidence.locator: v2 p.61, under 长春仙馆; source ref 5-339
evidence.excerpt_zh: 到处书斋号古香，每因稽古自徬徨。三谟二典分明在，扞格施行空望洋。
evidence.summary: Poem 古香斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1755, filed by the editors under 长春仙馆.

evidence.title: 古香斋: 乾隆五十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆五十二年 (1787), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 到处书斋颜古香，取名六十一年长。（予自雍正五年移住重华宫，即以东厢为古香斋践阼。后凡御园山荘佳处无不以是为名，屈指六十一年矣。）几曾书史得真味，祗觉昔今度幻光。修已蓬心惟有愧，治人蒿目更无方。对时又值春和候，汉诏勤民那可忘。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 古香斋, 1787, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 古香斋: 乾隆五十七年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆五十七年 (1792), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 重华斋额泐东厢（雍正五年皇考命予居重华宫，因颜其东厢曰古香斋践阼。后凡御园山庄佳处多以此名斋，以志弗忘），处处题斯志弗忘。却是简编一披古，即惭言行有何香。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 古香斋, 1792, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 古香斋题壁
evidence.locator: v2 p.60, under 长春仙馆; source ref 1-474
evidence.excerpt_zh: 书屋诚清绝，翛然水石边。时来听泉响，独坐爱岩悬。日永人偏静，斋深爽更延。忘言翻旧卷，仿佛话当年。
evidence.summary: Poem 古香斋题壁 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1741, filed by the editors under 长春仙馆.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 古香斋
evidence.locator: from p.174, under 长春仙馆
evidence.summary: A note of 1787 says he took the name from the east room of 重华宫, where he lived from 1727. 古香斋: 15 dated items, 1741-1805, of which 15 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: reading, remembering his forebears. First dated 1741, last dated 1805.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
